title: +*CALCULUS FOR MANAGEMENT AND SOCIAL SCIENCE
description: Focuses on differential calculus for business, management and social sciences. Explores limits, continuity, derivatives, and their applications for polynomial, logarithmic, and exponential functions. Includes optimization problems, curve sketching, and other applications.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 111, 111Z or minimum score of 060 in 'Math Placement - ALEKS'.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 111 and MTH 111Z.

Enrollment is limited to INTO OSU GE/AE/Pathways level students.
